nodes.label: ITHENA Brand Colour System
nodes.rationale: Palette is kept intentionally minimal (one brand blue, one accent red, a light/dark neutral system) so every vertical page reads as the same brand. Brand colours are fixed and never re-picked per industry; only neutral surfaces and text shift between modes.

nodes.label: Primary Blue #0083C8
nodes.rationale: Single primary brand colour for buttons, icons, links, badges and stat cards; theme-independent so it carries identity across light and dark.

nodes.label: Accent Red #C00000
nodes.rationale: Restricted to secondary-CTA fill only and never used as a background, so red stays rare and high-impact rather than becoming a second brand surface.

nodes.label: Dual Light/Dark Mode Brand Rule
nodes.rationale: Every page must ship both a light and dark presentation toggled by the viewer, never hard-coded to one mode; brand blue and accent red hold their value across modes so only the neutral system swaps.

nodes.label: Noto Sans Type Stack
nodes.rationale: One family for headings and body; ITHENA deliberately does not use a separate display font, which removes a whole class of pairing decisions per page.

nodes.label: Even-Pixel Type Scale
nodes.rationale: All sizes are fixed even-pixel values (48/32/24/18/16/14/12) with no fractional or fluid type, so pages built by different hands land on identical rhythm.

nodes.label: Eyebrow / Kicker Pattern
nodes.rationale: Uppercase brand-blue label with a 22px accent rule above every major heading — named a signature ITHENA pattern, so it is mandatory rather than optional decoration.

nodes.label: Alternating Sections with Soft Blend
nodes.rationale: Surface A/B alternate down the page with a gradient blend at the top of each section and never a hard dividing line, so the page reads as one continuous surface instead of stacked blocks with visible seams.

nodes.label: Corner Radius System
nodes.rationale: 10/12/20/22px plus pill (999px) and circle; sharp unrounded corners appear nowhere in the system — buttons and tags always fully pill-shaped.

nodes.label: Custom Hand-Drawn Line Iconography
nodes.rationale: No icon fonts or third-party icon libraries — custom-drawn 24×24 single-weight shapes keep the visual language distinct; icons inherit colour via currentColor so one shape serves blue, white and text contexts.

nodes.label: Solid Icon Badge Component
nodes.rationale: 48px circle, solid Primary Blue fill, white icon — always solid, never a pastel/tinted background, because a light blue tint fails accessible contrast for the icon on top. Stated as a firm brand + accessibility rule, not a stylistic option.

nodes.label: Pill Button System
nodes.rationale: Primary = brand blue, Secondary = solid accent red despite being named 'outline' (never a ghost/transparent style). Hover is a subtle lift, never a colour change, so brand colour stays stable under interaction.

nodes.label: Floating Status Cards
nodes.rationale: Elevated cards overlapping the hero image with a pulsing green dot (#1EA672) signalling live data — the motif reinforces ITHENA's real-time, connected-factory positioning and should appear wherever live monitoring is communicated.

nodes.label: Stats Bar KPI Strip
nodes.rationale: Solid brand-blue card with a three-column KPI strip; numbers count up on scroll to draw attention to proof points, or stay static for qualitative claims like 'Zero downtime'.

nodes.label: Zigzag Feature Panels
nodes.rationale: Alternating copy/visual two-column panels flipping order down the page — core to how ITHENA presents capability: narrative copy paired with a visual 'proof' of the platform in action.

nodes.label: Dashboard Mock Visual
nodes.rationale: Card-framed product-UI preview with a 2×2 status-tile grid; green = on track/nominal, brand-blue tint = monitoring/alert. This two-colour status language stays constant across every industry page.

nodes.label: Video / Closing CTA Banner
nodes.rationale: Two-column video placeholder + closing headline/CTA, used as the page's final conversion moment before the footer.

nodes.label: Motion & Interaction Principles
nodes.rationale: Motion is subtle and purposeful — it reinforces credibility and a 'live system' feel, never decorative flourish. Scroll reveal, stat count-up, live-status pulse and remembered theme preference are the sanctioned moments, and every animated element must have a reduced-motion static fallback.

nodes.label: Responsive Degradation Sequence
nodes.rationale: A fixed collapse order (heroes → 3-col strips → 2-col cards → full-width buttons) so responsive behaviour is predictable across every vertical page rather than re-decided per build.

nodes.label: Brand Accessibility Standards
nodes.rationale: Focus outline in Primary Blue, decorative graphics hidden from AT, proper dialog semantics with focus trap and Escape, reduced-motion fallbacks, and the solid-badge contrast rule are treated as brand standards, not optional polish.

nodes.label: Seven-Section Page Rhythm
nodes.rationale: Hero → Stats → Challenges → Solution 1 → Solution 2 → Business Value → Video/CTA banner is held constant across verticals; only copy, icons, dashboard labels, stat figures and imagery change per industry.

nodes.label: New Industry Page Extension Rules
nodes.rationale: Explicit constant-vs-variable split: colour tokens, type stack, section rhythm, radii, badge treatment and blend rhythm are fixed; copy, icon selection, dashboard values, stat figures and imagery vary. Icons must be semantically appropriate to the vertical rather than reused verbatim (don't carry bakery oven/flame icons onto packaging or defense).
